scientific_integrity: General claims proved by an analytic finite-difference integral and strict weighted-mean monotonicity argument; the bundled finite decimal diagnostic is corroboration only. General lifting theorems and classical finite-difference machinery are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only real \(\eta>-a\), integer \(m\ge2\), \(a>0\), and fractional exponents \(m-2<\alpha<m-1\). Results concern the specified scalar-weighted unilateral shifts and their m-th diagonal defects, not general higher-order concave operators; unindexed literature might imply part of the sharp comparison. Independent review not performed.
title: Sharp concavity thresholds and a finite-rank defect staircase for fractional-moment shifts
